title: DESQ: Dynamic-Flooding Transformer Ensembles for Reinforcement-Learning-Based Equity Market Timing (v1.1-desq)
description: Reference implementation for the revised IEEE Access paper. This v1.1-desq release adds paper-aligned Signal-Conditioned Double DQN execution, five rolling windows with a 50-anchor effective gap, canonical Tables 3-10 with evidence provenance, and Appendix F monitoring governance. Retained DES/CUSUM outputs are explicitly labeled legacy diagnostics rather than DDQN reproductions.
